sections.heading: Roles supported by the Trust Framework

rows: Can manage all technical resources of an Organisation — Applications and Certificates.
Can manage Data Providers, adding and removing API Endpoints and Certifications. Cannot manage Applications and Certificates.
Can manage Contacts in the Organisation. Cannot manage Technical Resources.
Has read-only access to Trust Framework resources. Cannot manage Applications, Certificates or any other resource in the Trust Framework.

blocks.text: Onboarding a user as a Secondary Business Contact (SBC) in the Sandbox Trust Framework ( https://web.sandbox.directory.openfinance.ae/ ) is recommended if the user only needs access to the Nebras Jira Service Desk via Trust Framework SSO.

sections.heading: The technical owner for applications and certificates

blocks.text: The Primary Technical Contact is the key technical owner within the organisation on the Trust Framework. The PTC is responsible for managing all applications and the keys and certificates within those applications.

items: Managing certificates (Transport, Signing, and Encryption) for each application
Keeping keys and certificates current and renewing them before expiry
Ensuring applications are correctly configured with the required roles and certificates

blocks.text: See Applications for more on creating and managing applications, and Keys & Certificates for certificate management.

sections.heading: Step-by-step in the Trust Framework portal

items: Log in to the Trust Framework and navigate to the Roles section within your organisation.
Navigate to a role within your organisation.

blocks.text: Users can be added under any role, but for easier management it is recommended to add all users consistently under the same role.

items: Navigate to the Domain Users section of your organisation.
Select the System as AlTareq Trust Framework and select the relevant user role — PTC, PBC, STC, or SBC.
Enter the new user's email address and confirm.

blocks.text: The invited user will receive an email with a registration link. They must use the same email address to complete registration. For a full walkthrough of what the user must do next, see Sign Up.
If a user does not receive the invitation email, ask them to check their spam folder.
